output.reason: The cited list item [ev-ed691386118f] only names the metric. Its section introduction [ev-1f419676f177] states the change concretely: Loki metrics that started with `cortex_`, including this one, now start with `loki_` in this release. It also says you keep the old prefix by changing `metrics_namespace` from its default of `loki` to `cortex`. That covers all four open aspects: subject (the metric `cortex_query_scheduler_queue_length`), change (renamed to `loki_query_scheduler_queue_length`), applicability (environments where `metrics_namespace` is not set to `cortex`) and consequence (anything that still queries the `cortex_`-prefixed name stops finding it).
